name: web_conduit
description: Control and bridge web AI chatbots (Gemini Web, Claude, ChatGPT) to Flowork OS daemon for hands-free autonomous terminal execution and desktop control.

action.description: Action to execute: 'status' to check connectivity, 'launch' to open browser with conduit extension, 'prompt' to print system prompt, 'test_exec' to simulate terminal execution.

target.description: Target web chatbot for launch: 'gemini', 'claude', 'chatgpt', or custom URL.

command.description: Command string to run when action is 'test_exec'.
